reviews.title: Best value air cooler I have ever seen.
reviews.comment: This thing is a beast. For the price you would be insane to not buy it if you are in need of an air cooler. I have cooled cpus from 30 watts to 300watts with it. Not tried to cool, actually cooled. Im honestly blown away. Just for fun I slapped it on my R9 fury thats bios modded for 375 watts, just to see what would happen...it kept it cool. Was in the lower 80's. Thats wild. The mounting plate is straight, no dips or out of round or anything. The fans work well and are pretty quite. It keeps my old ryzen 7 2700x super frosty. I have it overclocked to 4.225, which is about the max those cpus can do. The cooler isnt the limit, the cpu is. Its not a perfect bin and the cooler is playing life on story mode instead of nighmare difficulty.
reviews.author: Elemental_Sorcery

reviews.title: Great duel tower cooler!!
reviews.comment: This cooler is beyond amazing! I had a single tower cooler that kept my 14700k at 50c while gaming. I bought this and a thermal right cpu plate and installed it and boy does it keep it around 40c while playing the same games, it’s quite impressive for the price!! Easy to install and not too heavy!! 100% recommend this cooler
reviews.author: Harvey James
